youtube.title: Why Bottles Sound Higher as They Fill 🔊 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
When water pours into a bottle, the splashing makes the air column above the water vibrate at its natural resonant frequency. As the bottle fills, that air column gets shorter. A shorter column vibrates faster, which we hear as a higher pitch. That is why you can tell how full a bottle is with your eyes closed.
